text:
Elaine (Sales): Urgent 1: Aegis Capital wants an exec call tomorrow AM. CTO+CFO pushing on two hard blockers: BYO-KMS with HSM attestation and a custom short-term pricing floor under our published tiers. Need ops/security/finance on standby.

Michael (SE): Reproduced the KMS deny in staging. Their key policy blocks AssumeRole for our service principal. Short fix: ask them to add our service principal to KeyPolicy and we can route pilot traffic to a Dedicated pod.

Aniket (SRE): We can spin a dedicated cluster (ded-aegis-1) with strict egress controls. ETA ~30-40 min after we have their role ARN and allowlist. Will lock down KV cache so no cross-tenant leakage.

Priya (CS): I'll own the customer communications and craft the pre-bridge checklist. Need confirmation if we can offer trial credits + an overage cap instead of changing published pricing. That might keep finance happy.

Sofia (CISO): Security asks (high level): 1) HSM attestation PDF for their KMS, 2) proof of key rotation policy, 3) audit log access plan (export frequency & retention), 4) SSO enforcement + MFA for admin accounts. For pilot we can accept a scoped attestation + signed letter from their infra lead.

FinanceBot: Pricing guideline 1: Authorized reps may approve up to a 15% concession for first 6 months with revenue commit. Anything below must go to VP Finance for exception.

Michael (SE): Policy snippet to send them (replace PRINCIPAL_ARN):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "PRINCIPAL_ARN"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Elaine (Sales): Proposed plan: 1) Pre-bridge sync (30m) to align tech/security/finance, 2) Exec bridge with CTO/CFO 3) Follow-up ops handoff. Can everyone join pre-sync at 08:30 PT?

Aniket (SRE): +1. I'll start ded-aegis-1 provisioning now and post the allowlist template.

Priya (CS): +1. I'll draft customer-facing timeline and share the doc link.

Sofia (CISO): +1. I'll prepare the security talking points and a minimal attestation checklist to accept for pilot.

Michael (SE): +1. I'll also capture logs and a reproducible test case to show on the bridge.

deploy-bot: Provision event 1: dedicated-cluster ded-aegis-1 created at 2823457000. Nodes: p3.2xlarge x2. Network: restricted egress, IP allowlist pending.

Elaine (Sales): Thanks team. I'll book the two calendar blocks and add Aegis CTO/CFO + infra lead. Priya, please include the FinanceBot concession guidance in the pre-read.

Priya (CS): Will do. Draft shared: https://redwood.docs/poc/aegis/pre-bridge-v1 (internal).

Sofia (CISO): Also asked legal for a redlined NDA variant they requested. If legal OKs, we can run the pilot under that instead of full enterprise contract for the first 6 weeks.

Elaine (Sales): Noted. Closing the loop: pre-sync 08:30 PT, exec bridge 09:00 PT. Owners: Michael (tech), Aniket (ops), Sofia (security), Priya (cs), Elaine (sales).

Michael (SE): I'll capture the policy verification steps in the runbook and paste them here after the pre-sync.

Aniket (SRE): Posting IP allowlist template: 10.11.12.0/24 (example), please send CIDR for Aegis infra.

Elaine (Sales): Aegis infra lead says they'll provide role ARN + CIDRs within 1 hour.

FinanceBot: Reminder 1: If VP Finance approval required, escalation path: Elaine -> VP Sales -> VP Finance. Include forecasted ARR and pilot multiplier when routing.

Priya (CS): Good catch. I'll assemble the forecast and attach to the invite.

Elaine (Sales): Great work team. Will update thread with calendar links and any docs. :thumbsup:
